title: How The Vietnam War Birthed a Generation of White Terrorists
description:
Watch this video and lots of bonus content ad free at https://go.nebula.tv/stepback
Born in the fires of Vietnam, the White Power movement decided in 1983 to overthrow the government of the United States. But to do so, you need recruits, weapons, organization, and money. This is how they tried to build it.

Also, if you liked this series, it's mostly an adaptation of Bring the War Home: The White Power Movement and Paramilitary America by Kathleen Belew, a great read.
